justification: The DQ-103 probe read every served rule's full text in one query, which began hitting the 30 s statement timeout. The crash was reported as 'declared FIXED but the check FAILS', turning nightly data-watch and every PR's gates red. It now reads in pages of 2,000 by id, and a query the database cuts off exits 2 (UNKNOWN) instead of failing. Run for real: count 0, declared fixed and agrees. Same fix for DQ-104 and DQ-105 (dq_probe_unchecked_rows.py), via shared dq_db.paged_rows / pin_snapshot / is_timeout. Measured after: DQ-103, DQ-104, DQ-105 all count 0.

pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: id is integer and unique so keyset paging visits each row once

functions.name: _rows
functions.input: a read-only cursor on the production database
functions.output: every served row as council, document, text and dev type source
functions.if_none: an empty first page returns an empty list

functions.name: main
functions.input: the DQ id to probe from the command line
functions.output: exit 0 clean, 1 defect found, 2 could not measure
functions.if_none: a statement timeout exits 2 with an UNKNOWN line

functions.name: paged_rows
functions.input: a cursor, the columns to select and a constant WHERE clause
functions.output: every matching regulatory_provisions row, read 2,000 at a time by id
functions.if_none: an empty first page returns an empty list

queries.purpose: read every served rule in pages of 2,000 for the DQ-103 probe
queries.where_clause: is_current AND v2_is_actionable AND source_council IS NOT NULL AND id > last page id

break_it.scenario: the database is slow and a page still hits the 30 s limit
break_it.what_happens: old code reported a fixed defect as back
break_it.how: QueryCanceled exits 2, which dq_check shows as UNKNOWN, not RED

break_it.scenario: a different database error such as a dropped column
break_it.what_happens: it could be hidden as UNKNOWN
break_it.how: only QueryCanceled is caught; anything else still raises and fails

break_it.scenario: rows are added while the probe pages through
break_it.what_happens: a row could be skipped or read twice
break_it.how: keyset on increasing id never reads a row twice; a row added mid-run is picked up by the next run

post_merge.manual_verify: next nightly data-watch run passes the Defect ledger step

falsifiable_check.fails_when: the probe crashes on a statement timeout instead of finishing or exiting 2
falsifiable_check.observed_red: origin/main a6d2e378: psycopg2 QueryCanceled traceback, exit 1, reported RED by dq_check
